notes.title: 🌌 Venusville - Alpha 1.7 Patch 6 is Live! 🚀
notes.notes:
Big changes have landed in the clouds of Venus! This update focuses on core systems like pathfinding, colonist needs, and construction logic — making your flying city smarter, more stable, and easier to manage. Here's what's new:

🧠 Smarter Pathfinding (NavMesh Overhaul)
I’ve completely reworked our NPC pathfinding!
🔹 Switched from a grid-based system to a navmesh, eliminating awkward dead zones and improving how NPCs move around walls and interiors.
🔹 Some zigzagging or curved paths may still appear — I'll continuing to fine-tune this.

🏗️ Construction System Fixes & Improvements
Building logic got a major tune-up:
🔹 The Details Panel now correctly shows in-progress construction info, including missing resources!
🔹 Ghost buildings caused by deconstructing unfinished structures are gone. Platforms are freed properly.
🔹 You can now safely remove buildings waiting for construction.
🔹 The Deconstruct button is disabled during the building animation and re-enabled afterward.
🔹 Starport bug fixed: Removing a Starport no longer leaves fenced holes — platforms are restored and resources become accessible again.

☀️ Solar Panels Now Track the Sun
Power generation gets a visual and functional boost — panels now follow the sun as intended!

⚙️ Graphene Production Fixes & Nano Assembler Update
🔹 Fixed a bug that could break graphene and iron production in certain cases.
🔹 Graphene is now the default product on the Nano Assembler (Parts are not used yet).
🔹 The Assembler has a new 3D printer-inspired model — animation coming soon!

🧍 Colonist Stats & Needs Overhauled
Survival got smarter — and fairer:
🔹 Colonists now have four working core stats: Hunger, Thirst, Tiredness, and Health.
🔹 No more instant death from hunger! Now hunger affects health over time, giving you more warning and reaction time.
🔹 New alert system for yellow/red warnings on all stats (hunger, thirst, tiredness)  and health. 
🔹 Water Fountains (for thirst) and Beds (for tiredness) are now essential.
🔹 Reworked Behaviour AI ensures colonists balance work with their needs much more reliably.
⚠️ Known issue: Colonists may clip into beds when sleeping — fix in progress.

🎥 Camera Controls
🔄 Camera rotation with Q & E is now inverted by default based on player feedback.
🛠️ A toggle has been added in Input Settings if you prefer the old style.

📚 Tutorial Updates
🔹 The in-game tutorial now covers how to build Water Fountains and Beds, helping new players manage the new colonist needs.

🧼 Other Fixes
🔹 Minor UI and layout polish across the board.

Thanks to everyone testing and sharing feedback — your support helps Venusville grow stronger with every patch. 🌬️

Let us know how the new changes feel and what you'd like to see next!

notes.title: 🌌 Venusville - Alpha 1.7 Patch 5
notes.notes:
Hey Pioneers!

Patch 5 of Alpha 1.7 has just landed with some much-needed improvements to lighting, visibility, and fog, along with a brand-new tutorial system, event improvements, and a whole lot of fixes and polish. Thanks for all your feedback — it’s really helping shape the direction of Venusville!

[h2]☀️🌑 Lighting, Visibility & Fog Overhaul[/h2]
Lighting has received a major pass based on your reports of the city being too washed out during the day or pitch black at night.

Daytime ambient lighting has been toned down to reduce overexposure and washed-out colors.

Night side ambient lighting has been increased — it should no longer be completely black.

Night-time clouds now have a dark gray/purplish tint instead of being pure black — this helps a lot with visibility.

Fog has been significantly reduced, especially on both day and night sides. You should no longer feel like the city is covered in an impenetrable blanket of white or black.

Flying into deep cloud layers can still reduce visibility dramatically, but only temporarily.

Extra light sources have been added to the backs of buildings, and platform/fence lighting is now stronger.

Some exterior lights now automatically switch on/off depending on day or night.

A future patch will allow players to toggle city-covering clouds entirely.

[h2]🎓 Tutorial & AI Assistant[/h2]
The most requested feature is here: a proper tutorial!

A fully-voiced, multi-step English tutorial guides you through the basics and prepares you for your first night side on Venus.

A new AI character UI will appear when she speaks, giving you help.

Tutorial steps now appear as yellow messages on the left-hand events panel.

Everything is skippable — whether you're a returning player or just prefer exploring on your own.

[h2]📋 Events, Messages & Tooltips[/h2]
Big improvements to the event and messaging system:

Event UI now animates: messages drop from the top and move down — this makes it easier to notice new ones.

Blue information messages now auto-remove after 30 seconds.

Red warning messages still require manual dismissal.

New yellow tutorial messages disappear once a step is completed — or can be skipped manually.

[b]New alerts added for:[/b]
[list]
[*] Interior structures being built or removed
[*] Buildings being deconstructed
[*] Colonists entering starvation mode (in addition to the existing death alerts)
[*] Clicking on any message now attempts to move the camera to its origin — this feature is experimental!
[/list]

[h2]🧮 UI & Tooltip Improvements[/h2]
A few quality-of-life UI changes:

The top-right resource UI now shows the amount first, followed by the resource icon, consistent with the rest of the game.
A border now separates each resource entry to make it more readable at a glance.

The top-left altitude tooltip now includes habitable range in KM — no more needing to Google it!

Tooltips now stay within screen bounds. No more disappearing tips on the edge.

The Details Panel tooltip for power now accurately shows generation vs. usage:
[list]
[*] Positive = generation (e.g., solar panels)
[*] Negative = consumption
[/list]

[h2]🛠️ Fixes & Tweaks[/h2]
Pathfinding bug fixed where rotated buildings created “pockets” that NPCs could enter but not leave. This caused them to get stuck and eventually starve. A better long-term solution is coming in the next patch.

New buildings now start production immediately instead of waiting for you to click the production selector.

The Nano Processor now defaults to producing Graphene instead of Parts (which aren’t used yet).

Fixed an issue where engineers got stuck repairing fully healthy platforms.

That’s it for Patch 5! This update should make exploring and surviving in Venusville far smoother — both visually and mechanically.

As always, your feedback is crucial, and I love hearing from you on the discussion forums and the new discord.

notes.title: 🌟 Venusville Alpha 1.7 - Patch 4 Released! 🌟
notes.notes:
Hello Pioneers!

I've just released Patch 4 for the Alpha 1.7 Demo, bringing a key new feature and several important fixes to enhance your Venusian city-building experience. Check out the details below!

[b]🔧 New Feature[/b]

✅ Platform Repair – Engineers can now repair damaged platforms, keeping your city stable and resilient.

[b]🛠 Fixes & Improvements[/b]

[b]🛠 Restart Issues[/b] – Restarting the game from the menu no longer disrupts city-level data, including altitude, pressure, temperature, balance, structural stress, and vertical speed. The Status Panel UI (top-left) and city overlay indicators (zoomed-out view) now function correctly after a restart.

[b]🛠 Gas System Storage[/b] – Resolved an issue where the incorrect gas amount was displayed in the Details Panel UI. Toggling gas selector buttons now properly refreshes the UI.

[b]🛠 Gas Factory UI[/b] – Fixed a UI bug where selection changes did not update the display properly.

[b]🛠 Returning Gas for Redistribution[/b] – Now, when switching gas production or disabling gas storage, the gas is properly returned to the system for redistribution instead of being lost.

As always, thank you for playing Venusville and for all your feedback! Let us know how the new update feels, and keep an eye out for more improvements coming soon. 🚀

notes.title: Venusville Patch Update! 🚀🌅
notes.notes:
Hey Pioneers!

I’ve just released a new patch with important fixes and improvements to make your city-building experience even smoother. Here’s what’s new:

✅ Starting Location Fix – Restarting the game now correctly resets the starting position, preventing your city from spawning too deep and collapsing right away.

✅ Building Placement Adjustments – The build area has been refined to fix an issue where placing buildings near tile edges could cause them to snap onto the wrong tiles or even non-buildable areas.

✅ New Player Help Guide – A quick-start guide is now available via a new info menu button in the bottom bar. It also pops up when you start a new game to help you survive your first night! More help topics will be added over time.

✅ CVD Machine Fix – The Carbon Vapor Deposition (CVD) machine now properly switches between producing carbon fiber and graphene without getting stuck at zero production rate. Your NPCs will no longer be endlessly working with nothing to show for it!

✅ Stirling Engine Animation Update – These engines now correctly animate when producing electricity and stop when idle.

✅ UI Improvements – The status bar indicators (top left) now all have tooltips to provide more helpful information at a glance.

Thanks for playing, and keep the feedback coming! 🌍⚡ Let us know what you think of these updates and what you'd like to see next!

🚀 Venus awaits – happy building! 🌆💨

notes.title: Alpha 0.1.5 Update
notes.notes:
New in Alpha Update 0.1.5 (Patch Notes):

[h2]Fixes:
[/h2]NPC Behavior Improvements:
Resolved various issues causing NPCs to become stuck or tasks to reset unexpectedly.

[h2]Additions:
[/h2]
[b]New NPC Control Buttons:[/b]
[b]Stop:[/b] Allows you to request an NPC to stop their current task (useful if they get stuck).
[b]Motivate:[/b] Introduced to address hunger mechanics from the previous update.
NPCs in the yellow hunger state can be motivated to pick up a new task.
This does not work if their hunger bar is in the red state.
[b]State Indicators:[/b]
A visual indicator now appears above NPCs' heads when they are in yellow or red hunger states, matching the respective colors.

notes.title: Update Alpha 0.1.4
notes.notes:
[h2]What's New:[/h2]

[b]New Resources:[/b] 
Carbon Nanotubes, Graphene, Electronics, and Computer Chips.

[b]Machine Overhaul:[/b]
[list]
[*] Forge is now Pressure Forge (produces Iron Ingots and Diamonds).
[*] Carbon Maker is now CVD (produces Carbon Fiber and Carbon Nanotubes).
[*] 3D Printer is now Nano Assembler (produces Parts and Graphene).
[/list]

[b]Added new machines:[/b] 
Electronics Foundry and Chip Forge.

[b]New Models with Animations:[/b]
CVD, Pressure Forge, and Plastic Maker have been updated with new animated models.

[b]New Building:[/b] Vertical Engine.

[b]Recipe Changes:[/b] 
Recipes for high-tech buildings and machines have been updated to use the new resources.

[b]Tooltips Added:[/b]
Resource bar, details pop-up, and main bar now include tooltips for better usability.

[b]Colonist Hunger System:[/b]
Colonists now require food to function. If their hunger drops to yellow, they will stop working and search for food instead.

[b]Grow Pads:[/b]
[list]
[*] Now have two options:
[*] Potatoes: Produces vegetables and starch (used for plastic manufacturing).
[*] Onions: Produces 2 vegetables.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
Fixed Production Selector Bug.
Resolved the "wandering resource" bug.
Various other minor bug fixes.
